dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are concentrated on the mid-lateral flank. The most prominent structures show a soft gradient transition from darker perimeters to lighter, high-intensity centers. Geometry is characterized by irregular, non-uniform circular boundaries, particularly a central 'O' shape and several interconnected 'C' shapes with scalloped edges.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized high-intensity pixel clusters is observed along the dorsal ridge and mid-lateral section. The clusters lack internal gradients and form a dense, irregular mosaic pattern, transitioning to lower density and smaller, more isolated blobs toward the ventral edge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent 'O' rings form a roughly linear alignment along the dorsal-lateral axis, while the centroids of the two largest lateral high-intensity blobs below them create an inverted trapezoidal spatial relationship relative to the dorsal rings.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, diffuse region of interconnected light-colored pixel patches is visible on the posterior-lateral flank, creating a marbled texture distinct from the discrete annuli observed elsewhere.
